verdict.rationale: Weave documents an official W&B MCP Server that lets coding assistants and chat agents answer questions about runs, traces, evaluations and artifacts, and that coding agents like Claude Code use to read live production data and run evaluations. Separately, the Weave Service API provides REST endpoints with a full OpenAPI spec, including /calls/stream_query for programmatic trace queries. The docs-path OpenAPI 404s don't contradict this, because the working spec is served at trace.wandb.ai. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually debugging via the MCP server, and explicit documentation of metric-level query tools beyond traces and evaluations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent query my traces, metrics, and eval results through an API or MCP server to debug my app

citations.quote: The W\&B MCP Server gives your IDE, coding assistant, or chat agent direct access to your W\&B data and documentation... your agent can answer questions about your runs, traces, evaluations, and artifacts without copy-paste.
Using W&B skills and the MCP server, coding agents like Claude Code connect to Weave. They can read live production data, run evaluations, and execute automatic iteration loops on their own
Use the Weave Service API, which provides REST endpoints for programmatic access to Weave functionality.
covering the full service surface (117 paths, including /call/start and /calls/stream_query)
